AI recruitment for HR teams in the middle of a hiring drive: the applications keep coming, and the team spends the day on first-round phone screens. Call, no answer, call back, call again. Then the same questions on every call, while leave requests and payroll wait.

FineHR by Fine Solves has an AI interviewer that takes the first round. It runs the first-round interviews, your team reviews the answers and shortlists who to meet, and only the final rounds stay on the calendar. Once people join, attendance, leave and payroll are in the same system.
